note: Source manifest for the ORCH-753 gold cohort. The paper text is NOT committed; it lives at C:/t/eval-fulltext/<PMCID>.txt and gold.load_fulltext refuses a text whose sha256 differs.
citation: Zhu B et al. Complete biosynthesis of salicylic acid from phenylalanine in plants Nature 2025.
pathway_in_one_line: The PAL route to salicylic acid in rice: trans-cinnamic acid is activated to cinnamoyl-CoA, beta-oxidised to benzoyl-CoA, esterified to benzyl benzoate, hydroxylated to benzyl salicylate, and hydrolysed to salicylic acid.
scope_note: In scope: the seven-step CA -> CA-CoA -> BAc-CoA -> BA-CoA -> BB -> BS -> SA route and the enzymes OSD1, AIM1, OsKAT1/KAT2, OSD2, OSD3, OSD4, each measured here by in vitro assay with chromatographic product identification. Also in scope as an explicitly REFUTED conversion: the long-standing BA -> SA step attributed to benzoic acid 2-hydroxylase, which the paper argues does not occur. Adjacent, stated but not measured here: the isochorismate synthase route to SA, the beta-oxidation route as characterised in Petunia/Hypericum/tobacco/Populus, downstream SA signalling and SA glucosylation, and the subcellular-transport claims (BB moving peroxisome -> cytosol) which are inferences from localisation rather than measured transport.
selected_because: The single best chemistry carrier in the set: a complete, linear, bounded pathway where every step is stated as a named substrate and a named product and also assayed one step at a time. Fills the plant cell that the existing gold has zero coverage of. Moderate length. Risk: compounds are introduced by name then used by abbreviation (CA, BA-CoA, BB, BS, BAlc), so a drafter must carry the abbreviation table or it will produce unmatchable names.
